title: Tactical map request
description: Everything the tactical layer needs to generate and run one engagement. The strategic layer never builds tactical maps; it sends this. Spec: STR-022, STR-023, TAC-001..TAC-005, TAC-038, TAC-076, TAC-080, TAC-094, TAC-095, TAC-096, TAI-009, TAI-013, TAI-018.

seed.description: Seed for map generation and the battle RNG

rulesVersion.description: Version of data/mapgen/tactical.json, so a rules tweak never changes maps in an existing save

time.description: Strategic clock at battle start; sets day or night (TAC-003)

terrain.description: Strategic terrain type of the encounter tile (STR-022, STR-095)

biome.description: Biome of that terrain in the strategic terrain table (STR-095); selects the tactical terrain and prefab tables (TAC-080)

structures.description: Structures on the strategic tile (prefab tags)

settlement.description: TAC-086: settlement on the tile (sets map type town or city)

crossing.description: TAC-086: the tile is a border crossing

neighbours.description: TAC-086 / TAC-087: strategic terrain of the four neighbouring tiles

roads.description: TAC-086 / TAC-087: roads crossing the tile

approachSide.description: TAC-086: side the player squad arrives from (default: the road it came in on)

sides.description: Every faction present. The player side lists soldiers by roster ID with full state (from Management); AI sides list every soldier from its world record (STR-017, STR-023): id, rank, morale, zoneHp, attributes, perks, and tier = the squad gear tier.

role.description: neutral = the third side: never activates, only reacts or turns hostile when attacked (TAC-001)

morale.description: Squad morale: average of its soldiers' morale when the op forms (MGT-008); used only for units sent without their own units[].morale (TAC-095)

hostility.description: faction → faction → hostile (boolean) for the factions present

type.description: Only objectives met on the tactical map (TAC-076); strategic objectives (delivery, hand-over, holding a place, deadline) are never sent

battleGoal.description: Per AI side (faction id → goal): the battle goal and acceptable-loss threshold from the strategic layer (TAI-004, TAI-009). A unit's own battleGoal overrides it (TAI-018).

vipControl.description: TAI-018: who controls an escorted VIP; player = the player moves it, it never reacts (test option, default ai)

exits.description: Exits the strategic layer knows of, with their conditions (TAC-038, TAC-080). All are placed; map generation adds plain exits up to 2–4 (TAC-087). id is reported back as battle_result soldiers[].exitId

goal.description: TAI-009 (closed set, spec choice); retreat is never sent, the AI derives it from acceptableLoss

acceptableLoss.description: Share of the side's soldiers out of action: dead, or left the map (TAC-038); wounded soldiers, disabled limbs included, never count. Reached = retreat (TAI-009)

rank.description: Management rank = hiring tier (MGT); the highest-ranked soldier on the map leads the side and lends the Leadership bonus (TAC-094, TAI-013)

morale.description: The soldier's own morale at battle start (MGT-008, TAC-095)

controller.description: Per-unit override, e.g. an escorted VIP (TAI-018)

battleGoal.description: Per-unit goal for an AI-controlled unit, e.g. an allied VIP on the player side; overrides the side's battleGoal entry (TAI-018)

attributes.description: All eight attributes (strength, endurance, agility, perception, marksmanship, recon, medical, technical); TAC-094 breaks leader ties by their average

perks.description: Perk IDs the soldier has (data/management-rules.json perks[].id): player soldiers as recorded by Management (a perk stays once unlocked, MGT-009); AI units filled by the strategic layer by the skill thresholds. TAC applies them (TAC-096) and never derives perks from attributes; absent = no perks

equipment.description: Slot → item instance (item ID, condition, durability, contents). Slots: weapon1, weapon2, holster (a pistol on the battle belt, extra third weapon, counts toward belt capacity; DAT-005, TAC-042), helmet, bodyArmour, vest, belt, backpack

tier.description: AI only: the squad gear tier the unit is equipped by (STR-023); rank, morale, zoneHp, attributes and perks come from the AI soldier record (STR-017)
